description:
I wanted to make a feel-good type song, just brag about yourself but with attitude. I feel like these days people got money but don’t really know how to flex and maintain their flex. Like ok you got cash but don’t be stupid, why you cop those Yeezy’s but don’t spare money for your basic needs? Something like that.

CA$HMERE here literally means the cashmere fabric. Cashmere is a a low-key lit fabric when you think of it--it’s expensive, it’s luxurious, and it’s actually made from goat so it also has ‘that’ meaning. The song basically tells people that I’m so glam I’d like to be covered in cashmere (and cash) when I die rather than just regular shrout, like why do I want that.

I was really into that bounce sound at the moment--to be honest i was so inspired by G-Eazy - No Limit and NERD - Lemon, i thought those tracks really make the listeners move and i did want to create a track with the same kind of impact. So yeah i talked to Dexfa and he nailed the beat at first try. There isn't really much to say about the songwriting, i just wrote what came up in my head when hearing this beat like it just flowed really well. CA$HMERE is a bravado song and it's all about attitude, and there's nothing much to it other than that, it's a feel-good song and I hope that people will bounce to it too.
